spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (वहति)
To bear, to carry, to convey or transport.
(वहते)
To flow as a stream.
(इ) वहि r. 10th cl. (वंहयति)
To shine.
r. 1st cl. (वंहते)
To grow or increase; this last root is more properly बहि q. v.

m. (-हः)
1 Bearing, conveying.
2 Any vehicle or means of conveyance, as a horse, a car, &c.
3 The shoulder of an ox.
4 Air, wind.
5 A road, a way.
6 Any male river.
7 A measure of four Droṇas.
f. (-हा)
A river in general.
E.
वह to bear, aff. घ.

(ऋ) वाहृ r. 1st cl. (वाहते)
To endeavour: the root is preferably read वाहृ.

m. (-हः)
1 A horse.
2 A measure of capacity containing ten Kumbhas, or nearly equal to the weight of an English wey or a ton in freight.
3 A bull.
4 Air, wind.
5 The arm.
6 A buffalo.
7 A vehicle, a carriage or conveyance of any kind.
8 A bearer, a porter, a carrier of burthens, &c.
E.
वह to bear, aff. घञ्.

m. (-हः)
An ox.
E.
वह the shoulder, लिह to lick, खश् aff.

mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्)
1 Bearing, conveying.
2 Assuming, taking.
3

Wearing.
4

Having, possessing.
E.
वह to bear, शतृ aff.

m. (-तः)
1 An ox.
2 A traveller.
E.
वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. अत.

m. (-तिः)
1 An ox.
2 A friend, a counsellor.
3 Air, wind.
f. (-ती)
A river.
E.
वह to bear, अति Uṇādi aff.

m. (-तुः)
1 An ox.
2 A traveller.
E.
वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. अतु.

n. (-नं)
1 Bearing, conveying.
2 Flowing, as a stream.
3 Any vehicle.
4 A raft, a float, a boat.
E.
वह to bear, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 A vehicle, a conveyance of any kind, as a horse, an elephant, a carriage.
2 Carrying, conveying, &c.
3 Marking effort or exertion.
E.
वह to bear, in the causal form, or वाह to endeavour, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be carried or borne.
E.
वह to bear, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
1 Air, wind.
2 An infant.
E.
वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. झच्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Bearing, conveying.
2 Having, possessing.
3 Flowing.
E.
वह to bear, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Hard, firm, compact.
n. (-लं)
A raft, a float.
E.
वह to bear, aff. कलच्.

m. (-क्षुः)
A climbing and milky plant, (Asclepias geminata.)

m. (-रः)
A crab.
E.
वहिस् externally, कुटी crookedly, चर what goes.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
External, outer.
E.
वहिर्, and स्था to stay, ड aff.; also वहिःस्थित, वहिःस्थायिन्, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Known, celebrated.
2 Borne, conveyed.
3 Obtained.
E.
वह to bear, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Exerted, endeavoured.
E.
वाह to endeavour, क्त aff.

n. (-त्रं)
A raft, a float, a boat, a vessel.
E.
वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. इत्र; also with कन् added, वहित्रक n. (-कं.)

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
Bearing, conveying.
f. (-नी)
A boat, a vessel.
E.
वह to bear, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
Bearing, carrying.
E.
वह to bear, णिनि aff.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 An outer or external part, limb, member, property, &c.
2 A stranger, an indifferent person.
E.
वहिस्, and अङ्ग a limb.

n. (-यं)
An organ of sense or perception, an organ of action, as the eye, hand, &c.
E.
वहिर्, and इन्द्रिय organ of sense.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone out or forth.
E.
वहिर्, and गत gone.

n. (-नं)
Going forth or out.
E.
वहिर्, and गमन going.

m. (-शः)
1 A foreign country.
2 A place without a town or village.
E.
वहिर्, and देश place.

n. (-रं)
An outer gate.
E.
वहिर् for वहिस् outer, and द्वार door.

n. (-कं)
A portico, a covered terrace before the door of a house.
E.
वहिर्द्वार an outer door, प्रकोष्ठ an elbow, aff. कन्.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Produced externally.
E.
वहिस् outwardly, and भव born.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Being out or without, expelled, excluded.
E.
वहिस्, and भूत being.

m. (-खः)
A deity.

mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं)
Obtuse-angular.
E.
वहिस्, and लम्ब a perpendicular.

m. (-रः)
A crab.
E.
वहिस् externally, and चर what goes.

n. (-णं)
Expelling, excluding, excepting.
E.
वहिस् out, and करण making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Expelled, excluded, excepted.
E.
वहिस्, and कृत made.

ind.
Out, outwards, external.
E.
वह to bear, aff. इस्.

m. (-रुः)
A tendon, a nerve, a muscle.

m. (-ह्निः)
1 Fire, or its deity

AGNI.
2

Lead wort, (Plumbago zeylanica.)
3 Marking-nut plant.
4 Appetite, digestion, the metaphorical fire of the stomach.
E.
वह to bear, (the oblations presented to the gods,) and नि Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Making fire, lighting.
2 Stomachic, giving appetite.
f. (-री)
A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.)
E.
वह्नि fire, (appetite,) कृ to make, aff. अच् or ट, and टाप् or ङीप्.

m. (-न्धः)
Incense or resin.
E.
वह्नि fire, and गन्ध smell.

m. (-र्भः)
A bambu.
f. (-र्भा)
A sort of Mimosa, (M. Suma, Rox.)
E.
वह्नि fire, and गर्भ embryo; taking or producing fire by friction.

m. (-कः)
Safflower.
E.
वह्नि fire, and दीपक what shines like or resembles.

m. (-मा)
1 Marking-nut plant.
2 Lead wort.
E.
वह्नि fire, and नामन् appellation; the synonyms of fire being equally applicable to those plants.

n. (-ग्यं)
Ghee or clarified butter.
E.
वह्नि fire, भोग्य to be consumed or enjoyed.

m. (-न्थः)
A tree, the wood of which is used to procure fire by attrition, (Premna spinosa.)
E.
वह्नि fire, and मन्थ churning.

n. (-कं)
Water.
E.
वह्नि fire, and मारक destroyer.

m. (-त्रः)
Air, wind.
E.
वह्नि fire, and मित्र the friend.

m. (-ताः)
ŚIVA.
E.
वह्नि fire, and रेतस् semen.

n. (-हं)
Copper.
E.
वह्नि, and लोह iron.

f. (-धूः)
The wife of AGNI or fire.
E.
वह्नि, and वधू the wife.

n. (-र्णं)
The red water-lily.
E.
वह्नि fire, and वर्ण colour.

m. (-भः)
Resin.
E.
वह्नि fire, and वल्लभ friend.

Gold.
2

A particle, to be repeated as the peculiar prayer of fire in the Tantra system: the syllable Ran रं.
E.
वह्नि fire, वीज seed.

n. (-खं)
1 Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.)
2 Saffron.
f. (-खा)
A potherb, (Echites dichotoma.)
E.
वह्नि fire, and शिखा crest; also अग्निशिस्वा.

m. (-रः)
A flower, coxcomb, (Celosia cristata.)
E.
वह्नि fire, and शिखर a crest.

n. (-ह्यं)
1 A vehicle, a conveyance of any sort.
2 A cart.
f. (-ह्या)
The wife of a Muni or saint.
E.
वह to bear, aff. यत्.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
1 To be carried or borne.
2 Outer, external.
n. (-ह्यं)
A carriage, a vehicle.
m. (-ह्यः)
A beast of burthen, an ox, a horse, &c.
E.
वह to bear, aff. ण्यत्, or वहिर् external, यञ् aff.: see वाह्य.

m. (-कः)
1 A horseman.
2 A porter, a carrier.
E.
वह to bear, aff. ण्वुल्.

m. (-षन्)
A buffalo.
E.
वाह a horse, and द्विषत् inimical.

mfn. (-भ्रट्)
Falling from a vehicle, &c.
E.
वाह, भ्रंश to fall, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Employing, making use of.
E.
वह to bear, causal v., शतृ aff.

m. (-सः)
1 A large snake, (Boa constrictor.)
2 A watercourse.
3 A potherb, (Marsilia dentata.)
E.
वह to bear, in the causal form, aff. असच्.

m. (-कः)
1 A large drum.
2 A car, &c. drawn by oxen.
E.
वाह bearing, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Of burthen, bearing burthens.
2 Outer, external.
m. (-कः)
The name of a country, part of the Punjab.
E.
वाह bearing, or वाहिर् external, aff. ईकक् or ईकञ्, form irr.

n. (-त्थं)
The part of an elephant's forehead below the frontal globes.
E.
वाहिन्, स्था to stay, aff. क, and स changed to त.

f. (-नी)
1 An army.
2 A body of forces consisting of 81 elephants, 81 cars, 243 horse, 405 foot, a cohort, a battalion.
3 A river.
E.
वाह a vehicle, &c., aff. इनि; fem. aff. ङीप्, comprising the conveyances of cars, horse, &c.

m. (-शः)
A camp.
E.
वाहिनी, and निवेश encampment.

m. (-तिः)
1 A general, a commanding officer.
2 The ocean.
E.
वाहिनी an army or river, and पति master.

ind.
Externally, solitarily.
E.
तसि added to the preceding.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being carried or conveyed.
2 Being induced, urged, incited, &c.
E.
वह to bear, pass. v., शानच् aff.

f. (-ह्लिः)
A country: see वाह्लीक.

m. (-कः)
Balkh: see वाह्लीक.

m. (-कः)
1 A country lying north-west of Afghanistan,

Balkh.
2

A horse from Balkh, considered as one of a good breed.
3 One of the principal Gandharbas or choristers of heaven.
n. (-कं)
1

Saffron.
2

Asafoetida.
E.
वल्ह to be preeminent, इकन् or ईकन् aff., वह्लिक or वह्लीक; again, अण्. [] pleonastic or derivative added, वाह्लिक; or वाह्लीक, the conjunct letters of the root being transposed; saffron, &c. are supplied still to India, especially from Kashmir, Khorasan, and the countries in that direction.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born in Vahli or Vāhlika country.
m. यः
A Turki horse.
E.
वाह्लि, and ज born.
